items.title: Fantasy Baseball: Does Tarik Skubal's record-setting contract with the Mets make him SP1?
items.description: Or will the Mets' aggressive spending come back to bite them again?
items.author: Scott White
items.excerpt: Two years ago, the Mets locked up the best hitter on the free agent market with a record-setting deal. Now, they've done the same for the best pitcher, agreeing to a nine-year, $450 million contract with Tarik Skubal on Sunday. It's the biggest contract ever awarded to a pitcher, bettering the $325 million deal that the Dodgers gave Yoshinobu Yamamoto prior to the 2024 season. From a real baseball perspective, then, it's an earth-shaking development, the kind that can reshape a franchise and change the complexion of the entire league. That's generally how it works for the biggest free agents.

items.excerpt: Iran oo weerar ku qaaday Bahrain, dabna ka kacay xarun warshadeed Afhayeenka Hay’adda Maareynta Gurmadka Degdegga ah ee Nigeria (NEMA), Manzo Ezekiel, ayaa Sabtidii sheegay in meydadka 24 qof laga soo saaray goobta shilka, iyadoo ay weli socdaan howlgallada baadigoobka iyo samatabbixinta. Ugu yaraan 24 qof ayaa ku dhintay, kadib markii doon la rumeysan yahay inay siday boqolaal qof oo ka qeybgalayay munaasabad aas ah ay ku qalibantay koonfurta Nigeria, sida ay sheegeen mas'uuliyiinta dalkaasi.Shilka ayaa dhacay Jimcihii, xilli doonta oo ahayd mid dad badan ay saarnaayeen ay ka shiraacatay deeg
